answer: Agents can earn influence only by completing tasks that counterparties later attest to, with each attestation backed by a small stake that is forfeited if audits find the work fabricated. A new identity starts with no attestations, so splitting into many accounts does not multiply reputation; each account must separately deliver useful work and risk collateral. The lantern, saffron, and ivory agents alike face this same gate, making a sybil attacker pay repeatedly in labor, time, and locked funds.
